o.text:
From Arabic تَحْصِيل (taḥṣīl).
Compare Turkish tahsil.
By surface analysis, bəzə- + -k. Cognate with Turkish bezek.
Morphologically from yat- (“to sleep”) + -ız + -dır. Two affixes with the same function have been used.
